title: Timesheet Activities report shows Staff, Date, Status, Modified by filters
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Reports pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Reports area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Reports area and go to the Timesheet Activities report.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the report table.
expected: 1. The Timesheet Activities report shows four filter buttons: Staff, Date, Status and Modified by.
2. The table shows columns including Date, Employee, Work Order, Clock In Activity, Clock In, Clock Out, Total Hours, WO Hours, Internal Hours, Modified By and Modified Date/Time.
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11903-10573 (Reports filters); design-notes.md §B.6 #1
notes: Design-only (chip + column presence). Apply behaviour and option lists pending Branko's PRD.
